reviews.title: Solid lapel microphone solution
reviews.comment: This microphone is well built given the size restrictions. Depending on the speaker you may need to boost the volume on the channel but it is clear and natural sounding. There were no issues with feedback or noise.
reviews.author: Dumptruck52

reviews.title: New Shure microphone replaces original mic.
reviews.comment: The microphone is a Shure product and works well.  You need to be careful when removing the foam shield.  The top of the microphone did snap off as my user gripped the foam shield to tightly.  Otherwise, the microphone works well. The microphone unit snapped back on and was not damaged.
reviews.author: Ron

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.comment: I'm a wedding DJ.  This gets used with a BLX or SLX bodypack to mic the officiant when I'm providing audio for ceremonies.  The omnidirectional pattern of this mic is PERFECT for this situation; it typically picks up the bride and groom reciting their vows if they are standing within a couple of feet of the officiant.  Granted, it doesn't pick them up nearly as well as the officiant, but it does help enough so guests can hear the "I do's" through the speakers, and for this application I'd recommend this over the W93 or any other Shure lapel mic. Aside from the pickup pattern, the audio quality provided by this microphone is outstanding.  I purchased another one of these along with a BLX14 wireless set for my church for my pastor's use to record Sunday morning teachings.  When playing back recordings, you really get a chance to scrutinize audio quality, and this has exceeded my expectations. As a bonus, this mic is one of the cheapest of Shure's lapel mics! Shure never seems to disappoint.
reviews.author: Jim D.
